hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset conditions are risk_on, but the liquid names are flat-to-negative and the apparent long signals in XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile: identical conviction/composite values with zero volatility, expected shortfall, alpha, liquidity, and institutional scores indicate likely missing or default data. Keep exposure materially below normal and do not increase risk on the synthetic long signals.
